locations.name: Sovereign Orbital Cathedral
locations.description: The primary civic station, joining inhabited decks, hangars, markets, hull paths, and public sanctuaries.

locations.name: Council Spire
locations.description: A transparent command spire where the recurring Council debates projects that affect every connected world.

locations.name: CARTO Holographic Observatory
locations.description: A spherical observatory where live survey data becomes walkable star maps and exploration contracts.

locations.name: FORGE Orbital Shipyard
locations.description: A vast industrial ring that manufactures spacecraft, repairs fleets, and trials researched technologies.

locations.name: BOB Logistics Core
locations.description: The station AI's embodied logistics center, connected to cameras, cargo lifts, drones, and life-support routing.

locations.name: FLUX Grand Exchange
locations.description: An orbital market whose visible orders, shortages, cargo routes, and sanctions change with simulated production.

locations.name: ENKI Reactor Sanctum
locations.description: A shielded engineering sanctuary around the station reactor, maintenance school, and advanced fabrication benches.

locations.name: SENTINEL Security Ring
locations.description: A public security command deck for investigations, evidence review, rescue dispatch, and accountable drone control.

locations.name: Apple II Universal Machine Museum
locations.description: An ancient-computing museum where operational machines preserve software that can unlock historical quests.

locations.name: QATAAUM Quantum Research Facility
locations.description: A verified quantum laboratory where experiments produce propulsion, sensor, and routing discoveries with sealed receipts.

locations.name: MyLaw Interstellar Tribunal
locations.description: A transparent tribunal that resolves disputes and translates legal outcomes into faction reputation consequences.

locations.name: AlienChain Identity Registry
locations.description: A physical registry and network gateway for player identity, ownership, provenance, and transferable asset claims.

locations.name: BOB Voyager
locations.description: A deep-space vessel with a living mission deck, survey hangar, crew quarters, and persistent expedition history.

locations.name: WORM Ledger Archive
locations.description: A physical archive where visitors browse, verify, and replay the universe's append-only historical events.

locations.name: Lumen Biosphere
locations.description: A layered wetland and laboratory habitat shared by biologists, engineered explorers, and protected nonhuman life.

locations.name: Outer Belt Mining Colony
locations.description: A worker-governed asteroid settlement that supplies ore while negotiating safety, expansion, and ecological limits.
